passes: Motion status claims are event-gated and fail closed without matching runtime evidence.
Loading, working, reasoning-status, and execution-progress are formally separate state classes.
No glowing AI orb, neural particles, agent-avatar dialogue, fake percentage progress, chain-of-thought, celebratory confetti, or universal pulsing-dot language appears.
Mobile motion remains materially quieter than desktop.
Execution failure stops activity rather than escalating spectacle.
Decision lineage and memory supersession are reserved for real temporal relationships.
Reduced-motion mode completes with zero running animations while preserving status information.
Proof fixtures are explicitly labeled and are not misrepresented as production telemetry.

refinementFindings.finding: Canonical product clips depend too heavily on a floating top-center runtime-status pill. It proves state copy but does not yet make working state feel native to the conversation, inspector, or action surfaces.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Move status expression into the relevant product surface: conversation work state near the response origin, evidence state in the inspector, and execution state inside the action surface. A global compact status may remain only when cross-surface work genuinely needs it.

refinementFindings.finding: Structured Recommendation and Evidence clips mostly animate already-visible content. They do not yet prove the signature thesis that information moves from temporary work state into durable recommendation/provenance structure.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Stage canonical proof so recommendation sections become visible only when section-ready events arrive and evidence rows register into provenance only when evidence-source-added events arrive. Preserve identical semantic DOM; presentation state may begin visually unresolved.

refinementFindings.finding: The Approval screen starts in its consequence styling, so the exact-browser clip does not sufficiently demonstrate the product's strongest motion event: advice yielding to an authority boundary.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Begin the proof in neutral/advisory presentation and introduce the consequence boundary, authority label, and actionable controls only when approval-required fires.

refinementFindings.finding: Mobile continuity remains calm, but the proof animates the trigger rather than demonstrating the project/thread navigation sheet that the canonical UX contract requires.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Inject a proof-only sheet derived from the canonical mobile navigation contract and demonstrate one restrained sheet transition plus reduced-motion equivalent.

refinementFindings.finding: Runtime-state scenario boards can visually settle a previous row as completed while its copy still says Checking…, Reviewing…, or Running…. That mixes event history and current-state language.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Past start/active events become neutral historical entries with settled wording; only explicit completed/passed/ready events receive completed styling.

refinementFindings.finding: The Council review scenario validates participant truth but reads as a test ledger rather than a native coordination surface.
refinementFindings.requiredChange: Keep the event truth, but demonstrate the same states in a compact Council participant region attached to Structured Recommendation rather than relying on the standalone proof list as the primary visual evidence.

assessment.why: The truth architecture and accessibility contract are ready. The first exact-browser choreography is not yet expressive enough to establish state becoming structure as an AI Council signature behavior on the real product surfaces.
nextProofMustDemonstrate: product-native working state rather than proof-overlay dependence
neutral advice changing into an approval authority boundary
truthful historical versus completed work-state semantics
